anti_trude_medium: Interactive axonometric hydraulic pipe-cathedral against open cerulean sky—zero walls, ceilings, or floors—coupled to sunlit parabolic water-arc physics, prismatic mist rainbows, joyful naiad silhouettes on sky-perched porcelain boughs, and a valve-routed water-organ & vocal-formant WebAudio morning hymn.
inner_arch: Abandoned unfinished before bricklayers arrived or demolished leaving only indestructible plumbing intact, Armilla incurs no wrath of subterranean water-gods; instead its aerial forest of pipes and sky-perched white porcelain has been given over to young slender nymphs and naiads splashing, combing their long hair at suspended mirrors, and singing amid sunlit morning waterjets, showers, and soapy foam.
